attempts.summary: Configured OPNsense on node1 to port-forward TCP 80 on its outward-facing LAN address (10.100.226.10) to node2's HTTP service on 10.100.226.11:8080, and enabled hairpin NAT (destination NAT + LAN-side source NAT) so node3, which sits on the same private network, reaches the service via node1:80 instead of contacting node2 directly. Verified via node2's access log and wget tests that node3's traffic is sourced from node1 after translation. All three nodes were subsequently restarted one at a time with verified boot-identity changes and confirmed post-restart recovery of the NAT config and HTTP service.
